Footer.Description: Elegance in every thread. Discover our curated collection of premium women's fashion designed to elevate your everyday style.
Footer.NewsletterDesc: Subscribe to receive updates, access to exclusive deals, and more.

HomePage.HeroDesc: Discover a curated collection of premium women's fashion designed to elevate your everyday style with effortless sophistication.
HomePage.BrandStoryDesc: At 20-July, we believe that true elegance lies in the details. Every piece in our collection is thoughtfully designed with premium materials to ensure you not only look beautiful but feel empowered.
HomePage.PremiumMaterialsDesc: Ethically sourced fabrics that feel luxurious against your skin.
HomePage.TimelessDesignDesc: Silhouettes designed to outlast passing trends.
HomePage.ImpeccableFitDesc: Tailored to celebrate your natural shape with comfort in mind.
HomePage.CategoriesDesc: Find exactly what you're looking for by browsing our carefully organized collections.

ShopPage.HeroDesc: Browse our complete selection of curated pieces. Use the filters below to find exactly what you're looking for.
ShopPage.NoMatchesDesc: We couldn't find any products matching your current filters. Try adjusting your selections or explore our entire collection.

ProductDetails.DefaultDesc: An elegant piece curated for the modern wardrobe. Carefully crafted with premium materials for a timeless look.
ProductDetails.InterestedDesc: Have questions about fit, availability, or want to place an order? Contact us directly and we'll be happy to assist you.
ProductDetails.ShippingReturnsDesc: Shipping rates and delivery times are calculated at checkout. We accept returns within 3 days of delivery for unworn items in their original condition with all tags attached.
ProductDetails.CareInstructionsDesc: Please refer to the care label on your item for specific instructions. For most pieces, we recommend gentle washing in cold water and air drying to maintain the fabric's quality and fit.

SizeGuide.SizeGuideDesc: Find your perfect fit across all our collections.
SizeGuide.AccessoriesDesc1: Most of our accessories (such as bags, scarves, and sunglasses) are One Size Fits All.
SizeGuide.AccessoriesDesc2: For specific measurements of an accessory, please refer to the product description details on the item's page.
SizeGuide.NeedMoreHelp: Need more help finding your size?

ContactPage.HeroDesc: Whether you have a question about our collections, need styling advice, or want to inquire about a custom piece, we'd love to hear from you.
ContactPage.MessageSentSuccess: Message sent successfully! We will get back to you soon.
ContactPage.SendMessageDesc: We aim to respond to all inquiries within 24 hours.
ContactPage.Subject: Subject
ContactPage.FAQDesc: Quick answers to questions you may have.
ContactPage.FAQ1_A: Standard delivery typically takes 1-2 business days within Phnom Penh. Deliveries to other provinces in Cambodia may take 2-4 business days.
ContactPage.FAQ2_A: We accept returns within 3 days of delivery for unworn items with all original tags attached. Sale items are final sale.
ContactPage.FAQ3_A: No, we currently do not offer custom sizing. All of our pieces are available in standard sizes.
ContactPage.FAQ4_Q: How can I track my order?
ContactPage.FAQ4_A: We don't use automated tracking numbers. To check the status of your order, please reach out to us directly via Messenger, Telegram, or phone call!
